thread:
Ryan: Heads-up: Acme POC hitting streaming hang behind corp proxy. Non-streaming calls fine. Logs show `socket hang up` / `ECONNRESET`. They claim NO_PROXY set but SDK still goes via proxy.
Alex: Can you paste the env they use? HTTP(S)_PROXY vs lowercase matters.
Ryan: They sent: `HTTP_PROXY=http://proxy.acme.corp:8080` `HTTPS_PROXY=http://proxy.acme.corp:8080` `NO_PROXY=*.redwood.internal,localhost,127.0.0.1` Repro is the python streaming example.
Maria: Do they have any transparent intercept or a PAC? Those change routing.
Ryan: Confirmed explicit forward proxy, no PAC. Curl with `--noproxy` bypasses proxy. Only SDK streaming path goes through proxy.
Devon: FYI: Python SDK streaming used a lower-level http client; there was an upstream bug where wildcard NO_PROXY entries were not handled for the streaming socket path. We have an internal patch but not released.
Anna: TS SDK had a parsing bug when NO_PROXY has spaces. Eg `NO_PROXY=*.redwood.internal, localhost` ends up including leading space and doesn't match hostnames. We fixed that in a recent PR.
Alex: Two quick experiments: 1) set NO_PROXY to exact host (no wildcard) 2) unset HTTPS_PROXY to see if streaming then goes direct. Can the customer try both?
Ryan: They tried exact host and streaming succeeded. So wildcard handling is the culprit.
Devon: Good. We'll prepare a hotfix wheel for Python and a patched TS build. Also add a debug mode that prints computed noProxy entries so customer can confirm parsing.
Maria: I'll draft a short security blurb for their infosec: explain env var handling, that the SDK doesn't leak proxy credentials, and that streaming sockets will connect direct when host matches NO_PROXY. Include mitigations and the hotfix.
Anna: Short-term workaround for JS: set `REDWOOD_STREAM_ENDPOINT` to a specific hostname and add that to NO_PROXY (exact match). Less ideal, but quick.
Alex: I'll assemble a minimal repro script and a debug build that logs: env vars, parsed NO_PROXY list, and "using proxy: yes/no" before establishing stream. That should make it trivial for their infra team to verify.
Ryan: Customer validated patched wheel in their environment and confirmed streaming works. They asked for instructions to patch POC boxes and a one-paragraph note for their security review.
Devon: PR ref (internal): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482 Fix highlights: trim whitespace, normalize case, and check hostnames against noProxy list before proxy socket creation.
Maria: Action items: 1) deliver patched Python wheel + install steps (owner: Devon) 2) short security blurb (owner: Maria) 3) debug TS build if they need it (owner: Anna) 4) update presales runbook with this proxy edgecase (owner: Alex).
Ryan: Thanks all. Tagging sales-bot to record: POC AcmeCorp — streaming proxy bypass issue triaged, hotfix validated, security note pending. :thumbsup:
sales-bot: POC AcmeCorp: triage complete, hotfix validated by customer; next: send security blurb + wheel (owner: Maria).
